title: Tress of the Emerald Sea
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A teenage girl from a tiny island sails across a sea of dangerous spores to rescue the boy she loves from a powerful sorceress. She signs on to a pirate crew and learns that she can be braver than she believes.
readIf: you want a funny, warm, storybook adventure with a kind heroine and a wry narrator.
skipIf: you want Sanderson's long, intricate epics, since this is a lighter, more whimsical standalone.

pairings.reason: The same mix of fairy-tale adventure, comic narration and sincere romance.
A grown-up fairy tale about a quest across a magical border for the sake of love.
Set in the same wider universe but a vast, serious epic, for readers who want to go deeper.
